services: We remove tartar, plaque, debris and surface stains caused by food and tobacco. This treatment helps keep teeth and gums healthy, improves oral hygiene and leaves your mouth feeling clean and fresh.

We restore teeth affected by decay, fractures or wear, restoring their shape, function and natural appearance. We use high-quality restorative materials to achieve aesthetic and functional results tailored to each patient.
We offer fixed and removable dental prosthetics to replace missing teeth, restore chewing function and improve the appearance of your smile. Each treatment is tailored to your individual needs.

We provide teeth whitening and cosmetic restorations, including veneers made from composite resin, lithium disilicate, feldspathic porcelain and zirconia. When suitable for your case, we also offer ultra-thin veneers that require no tooth preparation, aiming for a natural, balanced smile.
whitening veneers resin lithium disilicate porcelain zirconia

We offer partial and full removable dentures made from a range of materials to suit each patient’s needs. These options replace missing teeth and help improve chewing, comfort and the appearance of your smile.

We treat teeth whose inner pulp tissue is affected by deep decay, infection or injury. Root canal treatment aims to relieve pain, treat any infection present and preserve the natural tooth whenever possible.

Crowns cover and protect weakened, fractured or extensively restored teeth, restoring their shape, strength and function. We offer a range of aesthetic materials for a natural-looking result suited to your needs.

We offer fixed dental prosthetics to replace missing teeth and restore chewing function and the appearance of your smile. We work with a range of materials and treatment options, aiming for comfort, stability and a natural look.

We carry out a comprehensive assessment of your teeth, gums, soft tissues and supporting structures. This helps us identify potential problems, make a diagnosis and recommend a personalized treatment plan, with follow-up care as needed.

We offer dental splints designed to suit each patient’s needs. These help protect teeth from wear associated with grinding and clenching (bruxism) and are selected based on an individual dental assessment.

We design custom retainers to help maintain the position of your teeth after orthodontic treatment. Each retainer is tailored to your needs, with specific care and wear instructions to help preserve your results.

faqs: Is there a fee for an assessment, and how are treatment costs determined?
The assessment fee depends on the type of consultation. After evaluating your case, we explain your treatment options and the associated costs. You can contact us on WhatsApp before booking.
How can I book an appointment? Do you offer emergency care?
You can book your assessment online or contact us on WhatsApp. We also offer emergency care and same-day appointments when available.
Do you treat children, adults and older adults?
Yes, we provide dental care for children, adults and older adults. We do not treat babies.
How long does an appointment take, and what if I am worried about pain?
The length of your appointment depends on the procedure, although many appointments last about an hour. Before treatment, we explain what to expect and the options available to manage discomfort.
Do you offer financing or accept insurance?
We treat private patients and do not offer formal financing. During your assessment, we can discuss treatment options that suit your needs and budget.
